svg.text: GPU Processor runtime sensitivity by input characteristic
Red (strong): slowest median is ≥2x fastest, or ≥1.25x with Δ ≥1 ms.
Grey (negligible): Δ ≤ max(15% of fastest median, 0.03 ms).
Yellow (moderate): between strong and negligible. White: irrelevant or not measured on GPU.
Color measures runtime sensitivity, not optimization priority.
